Frequently asked questions

Can I add page numbers to a PDF for free?

Yes. PDFEasy lets you add page numbers online for free without creating an account.

Can I skip the first page?

Yes. Enter 2- in the page range field. This adds numbers from the second page onward.

Can I change where the numbers appear?

Yes. Choose top or bottom placement, then align numbers to the left, center, or right.

Does PDFEasy upload my document?

No. Page numbering runs locally in your browser. Your PDF file is not uploaded to our server for processing.

Can I choose the starting number?

Yes. Set any starting number from 1 to 100000.
